performance_fast_path_contract.locate_reuse_rule: only a fresh frame with identical hwnd, geometry, dpi, and sidebar pixel digest may reuse the immutable visible scan candidate; the full screenshot digest remains bound diagnostic evidence, and every click still requires a fresh strict private-title confirmation
performance_fast_path_contract.pre_send_rule: the post-Brain pre_send_refresh must use a fresh physical frame; validators may share only immutable observations from that exact frame
performance_fast_path_contract.send_frame_rule: S0, S1, and S2 are distinct physical captures; OCR and calculations may be shared only within one frame
performance_fast_path_contract.fallback_rule: missing, conflicting, or unequal evidence executes the 0.9.10 full path without changing business state

finish_request.backend_proof_rule: task_terminal_requires_a_terminal_task; read_confirmed_requires_matching last_read_run_id plus completed_at and new_facts_or_no_change; failed_before_message_action requires no attempted message read and no message fact; read_failed_no_fact requires an attempted read with no trusted message fact; both failure terminals require an audit log
finish_request.local_proof_rule: every terminal kind requires the UI lock plus same-flow pending Outbox, Ledger, ActionJournal, and sent_ack to be settled; both no-fact failure terminals additionally forbid any same-flow Outbox, Ledger, or Journal artifact

runtime_control_contract.local_atomicity_rule: request_pause, clear_pause, begin_flow, and finish_flow must read, validate, and update runtime_control_v1 in one SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction
runtime_control_contract.row_lock_rule: set_run_status, start_inflight_flow, and finish_inflight_flow must serialize on the same Worker row with SELECT FOR UPDATE

ai_reply_boundary_contract.relation_rule: aggregate every recoverable gate: any after wins, otherwise any unknown wins, otherwise before_or_equal
ai_reply_boundary_contract.unknown_rule: after_two_real_attempts an unresolved reply-suffix unknown creates one idempotent handoff

action_result_contract.rule: OmniAuto owns action_phase and raw evidence; Worker is the only owner of result mapping. A missing per-item phase is conservatively treated as trigger_attempted and can never authorize a repeated physical action.

item_outcome_contract.merge_rule: completed and failed outcomes are monotonic; later empty or partial results cannot erase prior outcomes
item_outcome_contract.conflict_rule: a source_message_key cannot change terminal result inside one flow

message_limits.preflight_rule: persist the original complete outbox before compaction, size validation, or partitioning; transport compaction may remove only fields outside these allowlists

message_position_schema.safety_rule: screen_order may sort messages, but only visual_top may prove that one message is physically below another for state or handoff decisions

authoritative_frame_source_contract.initial_read_rule: allowed only when no voice or image UI action invalidated the initial complete frame; the original payload and observations must be preserved
authoritative_frame_source_contract.final_read_rule: required when the initial complete frame was invalidated by any voice or image UI action or by an observed concurrent page change, and must represent the latest stable complete frame before ingest or Brain
authoritative_frame_source_contract.action_journal_recovery_rule: allowed only for fact settlement reconstructed without reading or operating the current WeChat UI
authoritative_frame_source_contract.voice_orchestrator_entry_rule: voice prepare or execute may be called only when the current authoritative observations contain an executable untranscribed voice not already terminally settled

target_location_recovery_contract.classification_rule: only a performed visible-row click followed by a non-empty active title that explicitly does not confirm the authorized remark code may enter safe relocation
target_location_recovery_contract.terminal_rule: group, unknown with the target remark code already confirmed, empty title evidence, revoked authorization, or any message/media/input/send side effect must fail closed
target_location_recovery_contract.worker_rule: preserve the same UI lock and read_run_id, revalidate authorization_revision, discard stale coordinates, and execute search_by_remark_code at most once

recovery_attempt_rule: only a real checkpoint merge or a different-read-run stable reread may increment the reply-boundary recovery hold; transport retry, duplicate read_run, pause, offline, or timeout must not increment it
batch_continuation_rule: continuation_batch_id and continuation_token must be present together and may only advance the exact backend-issued batch

flow_gate_detail_schema.position_rule: a customer gate may be cleared only by a later human sales message; a failed self voice gate may also close at the same screen_order because that failed voice is itself the persisted human-sales fact

temporary_capability_gate_rule: temporary capability gates are request-level protocol gates only; Vision configuration and individual image processing must never use this mechanism

slot_ledger_state_schema.identity_rule: source_message_key is the only cross-round slot identity and screen_order is ordering evidence only
slot_ledger_state_schema.read_run_ownership_rule: origin_read_run_id is immutable fact ownership; fact_scope is derived only by comparing it with the active read_run_id
slot_ledger_state_schema.delivery_independence_rule: delivery_state and item_state must never determine fact_scope or history continuity
slot_ledger_state_schema.legacy_display_rule: legacy ledger_state may be emitted only for logs and compatibility display; business gates must not read it
slot_ledger_state_schema.history_gap_rule: only a historical slot below a current_read_run slot is C2_MESSAGE_HISTORY_GAP; unknown is an identity gate
slot_ledger_state_schema.safety_rule: only visual_top is strong physical-order evidence; observation_index_fallback must never clear a flow gate or handoff
slot_ledger_state_schema.uniqueness_rule: source_message_key and screen_order must each be unique inside one authoritative frame

image_transaction_recovery_contract.not_attempted_rule: an image action journal whose every item is explicitly not_attempted may be removed locally before the global transaction barrier only when it is a pure action intent with no terminal payload, no completed or failed ledger fact, and no corresponding outbox record; any formed completed or failed fact must enter settlement regardless of action_phase
image_transaction_recovery_contract.retry_later_rule: retain the exact ledger and action journal, block new UI actions, and retry the lightweight authorization check without reopening another conversation
image_transaction_recovery_contract.target_terminated_rule: only a backend-confirmed permanent target termination may mark the exact conversation's waiting image facts not_required and remove its image action journals
image_transaction_recovery_contract.unknown_decision_rule: missing or unknown decisions fail closed as retry_later

outbox_recovery_contract.retryable_compatibility_rule: data.retryable is display-only for legacy clients and must not drive new Worker recovery.
